initialFindings.topic: historical target validation before capture preparation
initialFindings.requirement: Bind the service-confirmed base scene to new annotation draft validation so target deletion between Done and saveDraft preserves the historical frame. Keep current annotation version and source ownership checks.
initialFindings.closure: First draft save carries view/baseScene/frame context and validates against the service-confirmed snapshot in the same transaction. Later draft reads, saves, preparation and Send share the stored source. Done-to-first-save deletion and forged history are explicit acceptance scenarios.

initialFindings.requirement: Publish immutable pixels and ScenePresentation together at the client display boundary. Done copies that accepted pair instead of pairing a placeholder bitmap with newer worker metadata.
initialFindings.source: HTML Canvas standard: OffscreenCanvas placeholder update during update-the-rendering
initialFindings.closure: Worker output remains a candidate pair. Main-thread visible Canvas commit updates presentedFrame with immutable pixels and matching presentation metadata; Done copies this pair. Worker-ahead-of-display is an explicit acceptance scenario.

initialFindings.topic: HTML native interaction and audio migration
initialFindings.requirement: Define the migration and acceptance boundary for currently allowed native form controls, contenteditable, clipboard and HTML-generated audio. Preserve current denied permissions and media resource policy. Any retained audio reaches the current client under its user gesture rules.
initialFindings.closure: Native controls, contenteditable, file bytes, clipboard and focus have explicit migration rules. Retained HTML audio is streamed to the current client under local gesture rules. Pixel, semantic and audio capabilities are separated; CEF PCM/timestamp support is a candidate interface and P2 remains unverified.
